actions.name: Divert Power
actions.description: Channel some of the additional energy that would've powered your mech's legs to add an additional +20 feet to flight speed until the end of the mech's turn.

description.value:
Only flight frames can take these lower limbs. The mech has limited maneuverability on land, but the less complicated component makes it possible to enhance its air speed.

The mech's land speed is capped at 10 ft., and its flight speed increases by 10 ft.
